text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Exports down, imports up in the first two months of the year, Central Office of Statistics says.
- Corinthia Group buys second hotel in Budapest.
- Man arrested for possession of live hand grenades.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sant given private overview of proposed Manoel Island project for large tourist complex including a yacht marina. Project estimated at $250 million is being planned by a Maltese consortium on Manoel Island, a tiny island in Marsamxett Harbour across from the capital, Valletta. Details are expected to be given at public exhibition soon. The government still has to decide whether to give the go-ahead.
- Opposition Nationalist Party complains over delays in publication of government statistics, particularly unemployment figures. Large public rally planned for May 1, Workers' Day.
